items.title: You can beat SOTA Time Series Anomaly Detection methods with a 100 year old algorithm [R]
items.title_zh: 简单的百年SPC算法在TSB-AD基准上击败SOTA方法
items.title_en: Simple 100-Year-Old SPC Algorithm Beats SOTA on TSB-AD Benchmark
items.summary: Claims that a simple 100-year-old Statistical Process Control algorithm outperforms SOTA time series anomaly detection methods on the TSB-AD benchmark, suggesting the benchmark is too trivial for meaningful evaluation.

items.title: 🤖 OpenAI 终止向 Cursor 提供模型，停服日期定为 2026 年 11 月 12 日
items.title_zh: OpenAI 终止向 Cursor 提供模型，因 SpaceX 收购
items.title_en: OpenAI Ends Cursor Model Supply After SpaceX Acquisition
items.summary: OpenAI terminates its model supply contract with Cursor by November 2026 following SpaceX's acquisition, citing distrust of Musk's companies' compliance record.
